Rule: Score-based eviction and volume control are independent failure axes: an insight ledger grows monotonically even when every lesson is correct, flooding the retrieval surface. Any working store pairs a wrong-lesson mechanism (evict at zero) with a volume mechanism (retrieval or scheduled consolidation/cadence audit). Solving one does not solve the other.
Action: add a periodic consolidation audit (dedupe/merge near-duplicate accepted rules, cap memory.md) alongside evict_stale.py; a store with only deletion and no consolidation fails on volume
Condition: When reflection/memory.md growth + audit cadence fails, drifts, or becomes unreliable.

Rule: On additive corpus change, do not blanket-invalidate prior reflections: re-stamp only after verifying that every cited evidence ID still resolves in graph.db. Fingerprint changes invalidate stamps, not evidence; a guarded re-stamp (resolve-then-stamp) avoids the stale-digest deadlock where valid evidence is discarded because the fingerprint moved.
Action: make check_reflection.py distinguish (a) cited IDs unresolved -> reject rule, (b) IDs resolve, only fingerprint stale -> re-stamp without re-running the full reflection
